attempts.question:
You are looking at the front camera image of a self-driving car.
Active navigation command: [GO STRAIGHT].

List what in THIS image the driver must watch to follow this navigation
command safely. Choose by relevance to the command:
- GO STRAIGHT: road users in or next to the visible lane corridor, traffic
  lights and signs that apply to it, crosswalks and stop lines across it.
- TURN LEFT / TURN RIGHT: the visible junction or road branch toward that
  side, road users and pedestrians near it, crosswalks there, and traffic
  lights or signs that control it.
- UNKNOWN: the nearest road users and traffic controls.
If this view does not show the route, list only nearby road users.
The command is route intent, not evidence that any object, lane or sign exists.

Each phrase describes ONE object or area: its appearance/type and its position
IN THE IMAGE (left, center, right, upper, lower, foreground, background),
usually 5-12 words. Example style: "a white car near the center of the image";
"a crosswalk across the lower part of the image".
These are format examples, not facts about the input image.
Put the most important item first. At most 5 phrases, together within
60 English words. Fewer is fine.

Do NOT include buildings, walls, fences, billboards, advertisements, trees,
vegetation, sky, parking lots, street lamps, or parts of the camera vehicle.
Do not read or quote text written on signs. Do not describe motion or state
(driving, walking, crossing, moving, stopped, parked, turning), future
behavior, intentions, or driving advice. Do not use ego-relative words such as
ahead, directly in front, or directly behind; use image positions in ALL cameras.

Return JSON only:
{"focus": [{"phrase": "...", "category": "..."}], "context": "..."}
category is one of: vehicle, pedestrian, bicycle, traffic_cone, barrier,
traffic_light, traffic_sign, crosswalk, stop_line, lane_boundary.
context: at most 8 words naming the visible road type, for example
"a signalized intersection" or "a straight multi-lane road"; use "" if unclear.
If nothing relevant can be identified reliably, return {"focus": [], "context": ""}.
